scorecard: Management consistently hits its EBITDA‑margin corridor but overpromises on volume and capex, with many targets either lagging or still untested.
business: Pidilite Industries Ltd reported its Q2 FY27 results, highlighting strong revenue growth and underlying volume expansion. The company is a leading Indian specialty chemicals maker focused on adhesives, sealants and construction chemicals for consumer and B2B markets.
bull: EBITDA margin hit 20% in Q2 FY27, within the 20‑24% corridor.
Revenue grew 21% YoY in Q2 FY27, outpacing prior quarters.
International subsidiaries grew 21.8% in Q2 FY27, boosting top line.
bear: EBITDA margin fell to the lower end of the corridor (20%) in H2 FY27, missing higher‑end goal.
Underlying volume growth of 10.7% in H1 FY27 falls short of early‑teens target.
FY26 capex represented ~8.4% of revenue, above the 3‑5% FY27 guidance.
